Psalm 3.1: O Lord, why do those who afflict me multiply? Many are those who rise up against me.
Psalm 3.2: Many are those who say to my soul, 'There is no salvation for him in his God.'
Psalm 3.3: But You, O Lord, are my protector, My glory and the One who lifts up my head.
Psalm 3.4: I cried to the Lord with my voice, And He heard me from His holy hill.
Psalm 3.5: I lay down and slept; I awoke, for the Lord will help me.
Psalm 3.6: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people Who set themselves against me all around.
Psalm 3.7: Arise, O Lord, and save me, O my God, For You struck all those who were foolishly at enmity with me; You broke the teeth of sinners.
Psalm 3.8: Salvation is of the Lord, And Your blessing is upon Your people.

Psalm 5.1: Give ear to my words, O Lord, Hear my cry.
Psalm 5.2: Give heed to the voice of my supplication, My King and my God, For to You will I pray, O Lord
Psalm 5.3: In the morning You shall hear my voice; In the morning I will stand before You, And I will watch.
Psalm 5.4: For You are not a God who wills lawlessness, Nor shall the evildoer dwell with You.
Psalm 5.5: The lawless shall not stand before Your eyes; O You hate all the workers of lawlessness;
Psalm 5.6: You shall destroy all who speak falsehood; The Lord abhors the man of violence and deceit.
Psalm 5.7: But as for me, in the fullness of Your mercy I will come into Your house; In fear of You I will worship toward Your holy temple.
Psalm 5.8: Lead me, O Lord, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; Make straight Your way before me.
Psalm 5.9: For there is no truth in their mouth; Their heart is vain; Their throat is an open grave; They deal deceptively with their tongues.
Psalm 5.10: Judge them, O God. Let them fall by their false accusations; Cast them out in the multitude of their ungodliness; For they provoked You, O Lord.
Psalm 5.11: But let all who hope in You be glad; They will greatly rejoice forever, For You will dwell in them; And all who love Your name will boast in You.
Psalm 5.12: For You will bless the righteous; O Lord, You crowned us with the shield of Your goodwill.

Psalm 16.1: Listen, O Lord of my righteousness; Attend to my supplication; Give ear to my prayer that is not with deceitful lips.
Psalm 16.2: From Your face let my judgment come; Let my eyes behold uprightness.
Psalm 16.3: You tested my heart, when You visited me in the night; You tried me in the fire, and found nothing unjust in me.
Psalm 16.4: That my mouth might not speak of the works of men, I held to hard ways because of the words of Your lips.
Psalm 16.5: Restore my steps in Your paths, That my footsteps may not slip.
Psalm 16.6: I cried out, because You listened to me, O God; Incline Your ear to me, and hear my words.
Psalm 16.7: Magnify Your mercies, O You who save those who hope in You From those who rise up against Your right hand.
Psalm 16.8: Keep me as the apple of Your eye; In the shelter of Your wings, You will shelter me
Psalm 16.9: From the face of the ungodly who trouble me. My enemies surrounded my soul;
Psalm 16.10: Their fat enclosed them; Their mouth spoke arrogantly.
Psalm 16.11: Casting me out, they now surround me; They set their eyes to bend down to the earth.
Psalm 16.12: They seized me like a lion ready to tear its prey, Like a young lion lurking in secret places.
Psalm 16.13: Arise, O Lord, outrun them and trip up their heels; Rescue my soul from the ungodly, And Your sword from the enemies of Your hand.
Psalm 16.14: O Lord, destroy them from the earth; Scatter them in their life. Their belly is filled with Your hidden things; They are satisfied with their sons, And they leave their possessions to their children.
Psalm 16.15: As for me, in righteousness I shall behold Your face; I shall be satisfied when Your glory is revealed.

Psalm 50.1: Have mercy on me, O God, according to Your great mercy; And according to the abundance of Your compassion, blot out my transgression.
Psalm 50.2: Wash me thoroughly from my lawlessness And cleanse me from my sin.
Psalm 50.3: For I know my lawlessness, And my sin is always before me.
Psalm 50.4: Against You only have I sinned And done evil in Your sight; That You may be justified in Your words, And overcome when You are judged.
Psalm 50.5: For behold, I was conceived in transgressions, And in sins my mother bore me.
Psalm 50.6: Behold, You love truth; You showed me the unknown and secret things of Your wisdom.
Psalm 50.7: You shall sprinkle me with hyssop, and I will be cleansed; You shall wash me, and I will be made whiter than snow.
Psalm 50.8: You shall make me hear joy and gladness; My bones that were humbled shall greatly rejoice.
Psalm 50.9: Turn Your face from my sins, And blot out all my transgressions.
Psalm 50.10: Create in me a clean heart, O God, And renew a right spirit within me.
Psalm 50.11: Do not cast me away from Your presence, And do not take Your Holy Spirit from me.
Psalm 50.12: Restore to me the joy of Your salvation, And uphold me with Your guiding Spirit.
Psalm 50.13: I will teach transgressors Your ways, And the ungodly shall turn back to You.
Psalm 50.14: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, the God of my salvation, And my tongue shall greatly rejoice in Your righteousness.
Psalm 50.15: O Lord, You shall open my lips, And my mouth will declare Your praise.
Psalm 50.16: For if You desired sacrifice, I would give it; You will not be pleased with whole burnt offerings.
Psalm 50.17: A sacrifice to God is a broken spirit, A broken and humbled heart God will not despise.
Psalm 50.18: Do good, O Lord, in Your good pleasure to Zion, And let the walls of Jerusalem be built;
Psalm 50.19: Then You will be pleased with a sacrifice of righteousness, With offerings and whole burnt offerings; Then shall they offer young bulls on Your altar.

Psalm 62.1: O God, my God, I rise early to be with You; My soul thirsts for You. How often my flesh thirsts for You In a desolate, impassable, and waterless land.
Psalm 62.2: So in the holy place I appear before You, To see Your power and Your glory.
Psalm 62.3: Because Your mercy is better than life, My lips shall praise You.
Psalm 62.4: Thus I will bless You in my life; I will lift up my hands in Your name.
Psalm 62.5: May my soul be filled, as if with marrow and fatness, And my mouth shall sing praise to You with lips filled with rejoicing.
Psalm 62.6: If I remembered You on my bed, I meditated on You at daybreak;
Psalm 62.7: For You are my helper, And in the shelter of Your wings I will greatly rejoice.
Psalm 62.8: My soul follows close behind You; Your right hand takes hold of me.
Psalm 62.9: But they seek for my soul in vain; They shall go into the lowest parts of the earth.
Psalm 62.10: They shall be given over to the edge of the sword; They shall be a portion for foxes.
Psalm 62.11: But the king shall be glad in God; All who swear by Him shall be praised, For the mouth that speaks unrighteous things is stopped.

Psalm 69.1: O God, make haste to help me.
Psalm 69.2: May those who seek my soul be dishonored and shamed; May those who plot evils against me be turned back and disgraced;
Psalm 69.3: May those be turned back immediately Who shame me, saying, 'Well done! Well done!'
Psalm 69.4: May all who seek You greatly rejoice and be glad in You, And let those who love Your salvation always say, 'Let God be magnified.'
Psalm 69.5: But I am poor and needy; O God, help me. You are my helper and deliverer, O Lord; do not delay.

Psalm 89.1: O Lord, You became a refuge to us in generation and generation;
Psalm 89.2: Before the mountains were made, And before the earth and the world were formed, And from everlasting to everlasting, You are.
Psalm 89.3: Do not let man be turned back to humiliation, And You said, 'Return, you sons of men.'
Psalm 89.4: For a thousand years in Your sight Are like yesterday, which passed, And like a watch in the night.
Psalm 89.5: Years shall be objects of contempt to them; In the morning let man pass by like grass;
Psalm 89.6: In the morning let him blossom, and pass by; In the evening let him fall off, be dried up and withered.
Psalm 89.7: For we fainted in Your wrath, And in Your wrath we were troubled.
Psalm 89.8: You set our transgressions before You, Our time in the light of Your face.
Psalm 89.9: For all our days failed, And in Your wrath we fainted; Our years were spent in thought like a spider.
Psalm 89.10: As for the days of our years, their span is seventy years, But if we stay strong, perhaps eighty; And most of them are labor and pain; For meekness came upon us, and we shall be chastened.
Psalm 89.11: Who knows the power of Your wrath, And who knows Your anger because of Your fear?
Psalm 89.12: So make known Your right hand to us, that we may number our days, And our heart may be bound with wisdom.
Psalm 89.13: Return, O Lord; how long? And be entreated concerning Your servants.
Psalm 89.14: We were filled with Your mercy in the morning, And in all our days we greatly rejoiced and were glad;
Psalm 89.15: Gladden us in return for the days You humbled us, For the years we saw evil things.
Psalm 89.16: And behold Your servants and Your works, And guide their sons;
Psalm 89.17: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, And prosper for us the works of our hands.

Psalm 100.1: O Lord, I will sing to You of mercy and judgment;
Psalm 100.2: I will sing and understand in a blameless way; When will You come to me? I walked in the innocence of my heart in the midst of my house.
Psalm 100.3: I have not set any lawless thing before my eyes; I hated those who commit transgressions;
Psalm 100.4: A crooked heart shall not cleave to me; As for the evil man who turned away from me, I did not know him.
Psalm 100.5: He who secretly slanders his neighbor, This one I chased away; The one with an arrogant eye and insatiable heart, With this one I did not eat.
Psalm 100.6: My eyes were on the faithful of the earth, so they might dwell with me; He who walks in a blameless way, this one ministered to me.
Psalm 100.7: He who acts arrogantly did not dwell in the midst of my house; He who speaks unjustly did not prosper before my eyes.
Psalm 100.8: In the morning I slew all the sinners of the earth, So as to destroy from the city of the Lord all the workers of lawlessness.

Psalm 102.1: Bless the Lord, O my soul, And every thing within me, bless His holy name.
Psalm 102.2: Bless the Lord, O my soul, And forget not all His rewards:
Psalm 102.3: Who is merciful to all your transgressions, Who heals all your diseases,
Psalm 102.4: Who redeems your life from corruption, Who crowns you with mercy and compassion,
Psalm 102.5: Who satisfies your desire with good things; And your youth is renewed like the eagle's.
Psalm 102.6: The Lord shows mercies And judgment to all who are wronged.
Psalm 102.7: He made known His ways to Moses, The things He willed to the sons of Israel.
Psalm 102.8: The Lord is compassionate and merciful, Slow to anger, and abounding in mercy.
Psalm 102.9: He will not become angry to the end, Nor will He be wrathful forever;
Psalm 102.10: He did not deal with us according to our sins, Nor reward us according to our transgressions;
Psalm 102.11: For according to the height of heaven from earth, So the Lord reigns in mercy over those who fear Him;
Psalm 102.12: As far as the east is from the west, So He removes our transgressions from us.
Psalm 102.13: As a father has compassion on his children, So the Lord has compassion on those who fear Him,
Psalm 102.14: For He knows how He formed us; He remembers we are dust.
Psalm 102.15: As for man, his days are like grass, As a flower of the field, so he flourishes;
Psalm 102.16: For the wind passes through it, and it shall not remain; And it shall no longer know its place.
Psalm 102.17: But the mercy of the Lord is from age to age upon those who fear Him, And His righteousness upon children's children,
Psalm 102.18: To such as keep His covenant And remember His commandments, to do them.
Psalm 102.19: The Lord prepared His throne in heaven, And His Kingdom rules over all.
Psalm 102.20: Bless the Lord, all you His angels, Mighty in strength, who do His word, So as to hear the voice of His words.
Psalm 102.21: Bless the Lord, all you His hosts, His ministers who do His will;
Psalm 102.22: Bless the Lord, all His works, In all places of His dominion; Bless the Lord, O my soul.

Psalm 129.1: Out of the depths I have cried to You, O Lord;
Psalm 129.2: O Lord, hear my voice; Let Your ears be attentive To the voice of my supplication.
Psalm 129.3: If You, O Lord, should mark transgression, O Lord, who would stand?
Psalm 129.4: For there is forgiveness with You.
Psalm 129.5: Because of Your law, O Lord, I waited for You; My soul waited for Your word.
Psalm 129.6: My soul hopes in the Lord, From the morning watch until night; From the morning watch until night, Let Israel hope in the Lord.
Psalm 129.7: For with the Lord there is mercy, And with Him is abundant redemption;
Psalm 129.8: And He shall redeem Israel From all his transgressions.

Psalm 130.1: O Lord, My heart is not exalted, Neither are my eyes raised up; Neither am I carried along in great things, Nor in things too marvelous for me.
Psalm 130.2: If I were not humble-minded, But exalted my soul, Like a child weaned from his mother, So You would reward my soul.
Psalm 130.3: Let Israel hope in the Lord From this present time and unto the ages.

Psalm 140.1: O Lord, I have cried to You; hear me; Give heed to the voice of my supplication when I cry to You.
Psalm 140.2: Let my prayer be set forth before You as incense, The lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.
Psalm 140.3: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth, A door of enclosure about my lips.
Psalm 140.4: Incline not my heart to evil words, To make excuses in sins With men who work lawlessness; And I will not join with their choice ones.
Psalm 140.5: The righteous man shall correct me With mercy, and he shall reprove me; But let not the oil of the sinner anoint my head, For my prayer shall be intense in the presence of their pleasures.
Psalm 140.6: Their judges are swallowed up by the rock; They shall hear my words, for they are pleasant.
Psalm 140.7: As a clod of ground is dashed to pieces on the earth, So our bones were scattered beside the grave.
Psalm 140.8: For my eyes, O Lord, O Lord, are toward You; In You I hope; take not my soul away.
Psalm 140.9: Keep me from the snares they set for me, And from the stumbling blocks of those who work lawlessness.
Psalm 140.10: Sinners shall fall into their own net; I am alone, until I escape.

Psalm 142.1: O Lord, hear my prayer; Give ear to my supplication in Your truth; Answer me in Your righteousness;
Psalm 142.2: Do not enter into judgment with Your servant, For no one living shall become righteous in Your sight.
Psalm 142.3: For the enemy persecuted my soul; He humbled my life to the ground; He caused me to dwell in dark places as one long dead.
Psalm 142.4: And my spirit was in anguish within me; My heart was troubled within me.
Psalm 142.5: I remembered the days of old, And I meditated on all Your works; I meditated on the works of Your hands.
Psalm 142.6: I spread out my hands to You; My soul thirsts for You like a waterless land.
Psalm 142.7: Hear me speedily, O Lord; My spirit faints within me; Turn not Your face from me, Lest I become like those who go down into the pit.
Psalm 142.8: Cause me to hear Your mercy in the morning, For I hope in You; Make me know, O Lord, the way wherein I should walk, For I lift up my soul to You.
Psalm 142.9: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, For to You I flee for refuge.
Psalm 142.10: Teach me to do Your will, for You are my God; Your good Spirit shall guide me in the land of uprightness.
Psalm 142.11: For Your name's sake, O Lord, give me life; In Your righteousness You shall bring my soul out of affliction.
Psalm 142.12: In Your mercy You shall destroy my enemies; You shall utterly destroy all who afflict my soul, For I am Your servant.
